## declared record arrays project as rows

ID: `lockstep-doc-facts/declared-record-arrays-project-as-rows`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A projection MAY declare `items` as the name of a top-level JSON or YAML array. It MAY declare `key`, the name of the field that identifies each record (default `id`). It MAY declare `link`, one of its fields whose values are repository-relative paths; that column SHALL render as a relative Markdown link from the target to the path, and a path that is absolute or climbs out with `..` SHALL fail. Its `fields` SHALL include that key and identify scalar fields in each record. The projector SHALL render one escaped Markdown table row per source record in source order and preserve the source link and markers. Each record SHALL have a distinct nonempty string key and each selected field SHALL be a non-null scalar. Missing arrays, invalid records, missing fields and duplicate keys SHALL fail before any target write. The check and installed refresh paths SHALL apply the same validation and freshness rules as ordinary projections; refresh traces SHALL record selected array facts and source identity.

## declared source facts have one authority

ID: `lockstep-doc-facts/declared-source-facts-have-one-authority`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`lockstep check project` SHALL generate Markdown fact blocks declared by `projections` in `lockstep.yaml`, each with id, source, target and fields, with an optional Python symbol. It SHALL read Markdown YAML front matter, JSON/YAML mapping fields and Python AST descriptions and signatures without importing or executing source. `--check` SHALL report stale target paths and exit 1 without writing. Generation SHALL preserve unrelated target content, include a relative source link (or an HTTP(S) source_base_url link when configured), escape HTML and table delimiters in projected scalar values, and remain idempotent. Consumers with no recognized OpenSpec requirement text SHALL project only declared facts, without creating an empty coverage page or rewriting historical plans.

## installed edit and merge paths maintain facts

ID: `lockstep-doc-facts/installed-edit-and-merge-paths-maintain-facts`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`lockstep refresh` SHALL refresh only declared source-local fact blocks without regenerating requirement docstrings or coverage. `lockstep init` SHALL install it as a PostToolUse hook for Claude Code and Codex while preserving existing hooks. It SHALL include `lockstep check project --check` in the pre-commit command so edits bypassing hooks are still checked. Refresh SHALL append one trace per run to a daily projection log with source/target hashes and rewritten paths. No declarations SHALL be a no-op.

## invalid input is not a pass

ID: `lockstep-doc-facts/invalid-input-is-not-a-pass`

Status: **implemented and tested**

Projection SHALL reject missing sources or fields, invalid or duplicate marker pairs and paths escaping the repository, including symlinks. It SHALL validate all declared fact projections before any projection write and report invalid input with exit 2. Targets SHALL NOT also be sources.
